questions.description: R045 Forecast & Planning. Current Bangkok month; posted actuals include partial today.

visualization_settings.text:
## Forecast & Planning
Current Bangkok month · existing loan book · baht. Gross interest and principal receipts are separate. Forecasts are scenario assumptions, not guaranteed collections.

Today is partial: the projected point adds only today’s unpaid dues. Future points assume collection on due dates; assumed arrears recovery is added at month-end. The initial 100% / 100% / 0% case is an unadjusted schedule, not a prediction.

### Upcoming receipts and forecast drivers
Stress reduces each Planning collection rate by 20 percentage points (minimum zero) and assumes no arrears recovery. Upcoming dues below are raw scheduled balances, independent of scenario percentages.

### Funding plan · all portfolio
Enter each of the five “Plan:” filters, including explicit zeros. Planned movements are after now through month-end. Include intended payouts only once. Loan-type selection does not narrow cash planning.

Month-end cash does not establish the lowest cash balance during the month or unrestricted lending capacity. New lending adds an outflow only; no speculative interest is assumed. Partner settlement entry stays in OLAP.

### Method
Recorded obligations override simulated dates. Automatic schedules follow the existing loan rules; manual schedules use recorded obligations only. Closed/defaulted balances are recovery-only and excluded from forecast receipts. Percentages adjust month-end receipts on one fixed schedule; they do not model delinquency feedback. Incomplete source coverage suppresses headline projections; detail shows known subtotals. No net-profit or forecast-accuracy claim.
